note: The regulation overrides this passage: students who could not complete course registration on time may still complete it during the add/drop period (Madde 25/3; Article 25/3). Do not say they must wait until the next semester.

The regulation overrides this passage on where to apply: a material-error (maddi hata) review is requested in writing from the academic unit the course belongs to, within 3 business days (Madde 31/2; Article 31/2).
The regulation overrides this passage: deregistration requires a written application made in person to the Student Affairs Office (Madde 37/1; Article 37/1). No tuition refund in any case.
